reason: The README describes a sidebar and bottom-panel workbench whose primary purpose is extending navigation panels with tabs, file viewers, terminals, Git, browser, chat, and task views.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 提供可扩展的侧边栏与底部面板工作台，集成文件查看编辑、终端、Git、浏览器、对话和后台任务页面。
summaries.en: An extensible DSH sidebar and bottom-panel workbench with file viewing and editing, terminal, Git, browser, chat, and background task pages.

capabilities: Provides a configurable sidebar and bottom-panel workspace
Registers third-party sidebar tabs and file viewers through an API
Displays, edits, uploads, and previews workspace files
Runs a real shell through node-pty and can expose terminal tools to models
Provides Git status, diff, staging, commit, revert, and history interfaces
Embeds sandboxed web pages in browser tabs
Displays side conversations, subagent topology, and background task output
